description: Search Danish companies in the CVR read model (read-only). Filters include industry, size, municipality (kommune), city/postnummer and region. Prefer exclude_reklamebeskyttelse=true for marketing leads.

city.description: Postal town (postdistrikt) as a prefix match, or a 4-digit postal code, e.g. 'Aarhus' (matches 'Aarhus C' and 'Aarhus N') or '8000'.

company_name_contains.description: Case-insensitive part of the company name, e.g. "Novo" or "Carlsberg".

exclude_reklamebeskyttelse.description: Leave out companies with reklamebeskyttelse (marketing protection, may not be contacted for marketing). Default true; set false only for research, not outreach.

industry_code.description: Exact Danish industry code (DB25/NACE, up to 6 digits), e.g. "621000" (computer programming).

industry_contains.description: Case-insensitive text match on the industry name and secondary industries (Danish), e.g. "tømrer", "software" or "restaurant".

limit.description: Number of companies to return (1 to 50), e.g. 20. Default 20.

max_employees.description: Maximum average number of employees from the latest annual report, e.g. 50.

max_revenue.description: Maximum revenue in DKK from the latest annual report, e.g. 50000000 for 50 million DKK.

min_employees.description: Minimum average number of employees from the latest annual report, e.g. 10.

min_revenue.description: Minimum revenue (omsætning) in DKK from the latest annual report, e.g. 10000000 for 10 million DKK.

municipality.description: Municipality (kommune) of the current CVR address, by name or code, e.g. 'Aarhus', 'Københavns Kommune' or '751'.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging, e.g. 20 for page 2 with limit 20. Default 0.

region.description: Danish region, e.g. 'Midtjylland'. One of Hovedstaden, Sjælland, Syddanmark, Midtjylland, Nordjylland ('Region ' prefix optional).

status_contains.description: Case-insensitive part of the CVR status (Danish), e.g. "normal" or "aktiv" for active companies, "konkurs" for bankruptcy.

name: search_companies
title: Search Danish companies
